content.content: Each module is a single `.rs` file directly under `src/`, named `<group>_<part>.rs` (`store_path.rs`, `verb_show.rs`). There are no nested module directories and no `mod.rs`. The module tree is declared once, at the crate root (`src/lib.rs`): that declaration is the module set.
content.rationale: Rust makes a directory module enumerate its children in a shared `mod.rs` — a file that must change every time a module is added. Flat files avoid it: each module stands alone and the module tree is declared once at the crate root.
